draft_text: On identical hardware at batch size 16, Nimbrake delivers higher throughput than Caskline on Driftbay-Serve, at 142 versus 119 requests per second.
revised_text: On identical hardware, Nimbrake delivered 142 requests per second and Caskline 119 requests per second on Driftbay-Serve; however, Nimbrake used batch size 32 and Caskline batch size 16, so the figures are not directly comparable.
rationale: The claim states "at batch size 16" for Nimbrake, but the table note says Nimbrake used batch size 32 and Caskline used batch size 16, so the figures are not directly comparable. The numbers 142 and 119 are correct, but the batch-size framing misstates the setup.
